C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n3 n2 n4 VSS
L Ls n4 n5
L Ld VDD n3

C Cout n5 VOUT1
rationale: The previous topology suffers from severe noise and gain degradation, with the noise figure (NF) and S21 far exceeding requirements. The binding constraint is NF_db, which is 42.2 dB over spec (margin: -12.07), indicating a fundamental issue in the input stage's transconductance and noise contribution. The lack of a source degeneration inductor or proper impedance matching network results in poor input matching and excessive noise. To improve the NF and S21 simultaneously without breaking other constraints, we add a source inductor (Ls) in series with the NMOS source to provide inductive peaking and enhance input matching, which improves both gain and noise performance by increasing effective transconductance and reducing noise contribution from the source resistance. This is a standard technique in narrowband LNAs to achieve higher gain and lower NF at 1.575 GHz.
